title: Cipher and Safehouse Again
author: Wendell Pemberton
blurb: Kestrel Iversen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
